'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Jarad Konsker LS Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jarad Konsker]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers|Theed-L-naboobossnassschambers.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Jarad
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
